test_is_lexsorted: test the MultiIndex._is_lexsorted method to verify whether a MultiIndex is lexsorted
test_lexsort_depth: test the MultiIndex._lexsort_depth property to check the lexsort depth of a MultiIndex
create_multiindex_lexsorted: create a MultiIndex with levels and codes that produces a lexsorted index
create_multiindex_unsorted: create a MultiIndex with levels and codes that produces a non-lexsorted index
build_multiindex_sortorder: build a MultiIndex with a specified sortorder parameter to set lexsort depth
